chapterTitle: The Inner-Front Strategy: Destroy from Within
coreMove: Some systems are only vulnerable through internal contradictions that can be surfaced or amplified until cohesion fails.
modernTranslation: Expose and intensify real internal fault lines; do not romanticize subversion or fabricate instability.

ethicalSplit.legitimate: Clarifying real contradictions and refusing to rescue a divided system from consequences already inside it.
ethicalSplit.illegitimate: Planting falsehoods, manufacturing mistrust, or corroding groups that are not properly opponents.
